notes: kb/Work PB5923 (closed by step 1 of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18). §1985:VI.3.4.4 GR1: "The paragraph-name DATE-COMPILED causes the current date to be inserted during program compilation. If a DATE-COMPILED paragraph is present, it is replaced during compilation with a paragraph of the form" DATE-COMPILED. current date.; §1985:VI.3.4.1 places that date in "the Identification Division source program listing". At --std 85 the compiler now produces the listing §1985:IV.7.1 requires (on by default; docs/manual/user-guide/listing.md). SourceUnitFacts.Read finds each DATE-COMPILED paragraph on the parse tree, and SourceSectionBuilder.ReplaceDateCompiled prints, in place of the paragraph's first line from the paragraph word on, ListingTimestamp.DateCompiledParagraph of the compilation's one instant (CompilationInputs.ReadCompilationTime captures it once, so the page heading and WHEN-COMPILED denote the same time), and replaces the further lines of the comment-entry with it. The witness reads the instant the listing records, checks it lies between two clock readings taken around the compile, and checks the replaced row, the heading and the program's WHEN-COMPILED against it.

No 2023 clause holds the DATE-COMPILED feature. The wording candidates cover other paragraphs (SPECIAL-NAMES, REPOSITORY, OPTIONS etc.), so 2023 lacks this paragraph.
